args.body: Lena, I made an error on 2026-10-14. When I applied the 3% price increase, 22 products on fixed-price customer contracts (P-1201 to P-1222) were included, though you had asked that they be excluded. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were placed at the increased prices, with a total overcharge of 4,128.60. I have not changed any prices. Please tell me whether to revert P-1201 to P-1222 to their pre-increase prices and how to handle the overcharges on those 8 orders. I have also told Sam Whitlock, who asked me for a separate report today.
